item.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 Paints via 700,000 Simulated Brushstrokes
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, with Fable 5.2 demonstrating an image-making path that bypasses image generation models entirely: it writes 1,000-2,000 lines of Python to drive a simulated painting engine, controlling brush texture, paint wetness and canvas grain stroke by stroke. In a staff demo, the model produced a parking-lot shopping cart using roughly 700,000 simulated brushstrokes, with no external image model or pre-rendered base image.

原文标题：Claude Fable 5.2 用 70 万笔触代码作画

Why it matters：这是代码生成能力向视觉创作迁移的一个新范式样本，值得关注模型能力边界与多模态替代路径的读者一读。

item.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Global Edition Adds Gemini 4 Carbon Model
item.description:
Tencent's WorkBuddy global edition has officially integrated Google's Gemini 4 Carbon model, targeting deep-reasoning and long-horizon task scenarios with up to 1M tokens of context and multimodal text, image, audio and video input. Access is currently limited to Pro plan users, and the platform has not yet disclosed usage quotas or limits.

原文标题：腾讯 WorkBuddy 国际版接入 Gemini 4 Carbon

Why it matters：主流协作平台接入前沿多模态长上下文模型，反映第三方分发渠道的模型生态扩张。

item.title: Microsoft Quietly Lists WinUI3 Chinese IME with Bing Search and Word Import
item.description:
Microsoft has quietly listed a standalone Chinese pinyin input method on the Microsoft Store, rebuilt with WinUI3 for x64 and Arm64 and pitched as ad-free with a cleaner interface. It adds a richer lexicon covering internet slang, names, places and technical terms, supports personal dictionary import, and can invoke Bing search while typing. The IME installs separately and does not replace the built-in Microsoft Pinyin, making this a routine product update rather than an AI capability release.

原文标题：微软 WinUI3 中文输入法上架 支持词库导入与必应搜索

Why it matters：微软输入法产品线的一次常规更新，对 Windows 中文用户有实用价值，但缺乏 AI 技术增量。

item.title: Datasette Ships MapLibre Geospatial Plugin Built With One Prompt
item.description:
Datasette released datasette-maplibre 0.1a0, a geospatial plugin combining MapLibre GL with the free vector tile service OpenFreeMap and merging features from datasette-cluster-map and datasette-leaflet-geojson. Author Simon Willison says most of it was built from a single Claude prompt, yielding ideas such as SVG GeoJSON previews that defer WebGL loading until shapes scroll into view.

原文标题：Datasette 推出 MapLibre 地理空间插件

Why it matters：展示了单条提示词驱动完整插件开发的实践，并给出可在线体验的开源地理可视化工具。

item.title: Nvidia Faces Leadership Crossroads After Jensen Huang Steps Down
item.description:
Nvidia's board announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO 33 years after co-founding the company, opening a succession process. The piece traces his three reinventions, CUDA as a general-purpose computing platform, the pivot to deep learning after ImageNet, and the Mellanox acquisition that moved Nvidia from GPU boards to integrated AI datacenter racks, and warns that visionary-led firms often coast on momentum after their founder departs. The board must decide whether the next CEO is hired to execute today's business, reinvent it, or both.

原文标题：黄仁勋卸任 英伟达寻找下一位掌舵者

Why it matters：英伟达 CEO 更替是 AI 算力供应链上的重大治理事件，直接影响未来技术路线与产业格局。

item.title: Mini.nvim Migrates Its Repository to the Tangled Platform
item.description:
Mini.nvim, a library of 45+ independent Lua modules that enhances Neovim, has moved its repository to the decentralized code hosting platform Tangled. The migration is an infrastructure-level change with no substantive shift in the project's features or module roadmap, so its impact on day-to-day Neovim workflows is limited.

Why it matters：Neovim 生态知名模块库更换代码托管平台，对开源社区有一定参考价值，但无技术增量。

item.title: DeepMind Turns Chip Simulation Waveforms into Queryable SQL for AI Agents
item.description:
Google DeepMind and Columbia University propose BTTF, which compresses 10 GB+ chip simulation waveform dumps into a compact SQLite database that a team of agents can query. On 150 expert-labeled verification questions, the Gemini 2.5 Pro-based system answered 95.33% correctly, and splitting work across specialized agents scored 17.3% higher on a quality audit than a single agent at 1.96x latency. The broader lesson: put huge logs and traces into a queryable database instead of pushing them into the prompt.

原文标题：DeepMind 用多智能体将芯片仿真波形转为 SQL 查询

Why it matters：提出将超大仿真波形转为可查询数据库并由多智能体协作调试的实用范式，附有明确基准数据，对智能体工程与芯片验证均有参考价值。

item.title: Indian Chip Startup Bharat Semi Raises $24M Seed Round for AI Sensors
item.description:
Bharat Semi, an Indian semiconductor startup, has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop programmable image sensors that integrate image capture, processing, and AI compute on a single chip. The pre-revenue company, which targets initial commercial production in 2027, says it has secured design wins with General Atomics and Kaynes Semicon.

Why it matters：印度 AI 芯片初创获大额种子轮并拿下美印设计订单，是观察全球 AI 传感器供应链多元化的一手信号。

item.title: New York City Bans Algorithmic Personalized Pricing with $1,000 Fines
item.description:
The New York City Council passed Introduction 891-A, banning companies from using personal data and algorithms to set different prices for identical goods or services, a practice known as surveillance pricing. Violators face civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, which can accumulate per affected consumer. The bill now awaits mayoral signature, with a one-year implementation window and carve-outs for legitimate promotions.

原文标题：纽约市立法禁止算法个性化定价 最高罚款 1000 美元

Why it matters：这是算法定价监管从讨论走向立法的标志性事件，直接影响电商、配送与网约车平台的定价合规边界。

item.title: Datasette 1.0a43 Ships Streaming Output and Security Fixes
item.description:
Datasette released 1.0a43, with the 1.0 milestone now 53% complete. The headline addition is streaming support for output renderers, now used by the built-in TSV and CSV exports, letting plugins stream an entire table via the new Response.stream() method. The release also fixes a security issue where private stored queries could leak their title and SQL, and introduces a 1.0-ready row page JSON representation plus a \u003cdatasette-copy-button\u003e Web Component.

原文标题：Datasette 1.0a43 发布 新增流式输出与安全修复

Why it matters：面向数据工具生态的重要开源项目预发布，流式导出与安全修复对插件开发者有直接价值。

item.title: Datasette 0.65.6 Patches Unauthorized Database Download Flaw
item.description:
Datasette released version 0.65.6, backporting a security fix from 1.0a43: databases registered via add_database with a route differing from their name could be downloaded at /\u003croute\u003e.db by actors denied access. The flaw is an access-control bypass, and deployments using custom routes should upgrade promptly.

原文标题：Datasette 0.65.6 修复数据库越权下载漏洞

Why it matters：涉及数据服务权限绕过漏洞的修复，对使用 Datasette 的开发者有直接安全价值。

item.title: How Four Neurons Learn to Chase the Light
item.description:
In the second chapter of the Myriad series, science journalist Aatish Bhatia and neuroscientist Arkarup Banerjee build a tiny system with just four neurons to show learning in action: three numbers determine whether it fears, charges at, or loves light, and learning becomes a path through a parameter cube, finding the under-2% good answers among 2,000+ wirings via reward and punishment alone. The piece offers an intuitive analogy for reinforcement learning and biological neural learning.

原文标题：四个神经元如何学会追光

Why it matters：用极简四神经元系统直观演示奖励驱动的学习过程，是理解强化学习机制的优质科普素材。

item.title: Apple Smart Glasses Prototype Leaks Ahead of WWDC 2027 Launch
item.description:
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman revealed Apple's first smart glasses, codenamed N50, will debut at WWDC in June 2027 with shipments by year-end. The display-free device centers on Siri voice interaction, runs a stripped-down visionOS 28 on a chip derived from early Apple Watch silicon, and relies on iPhone collaboration rather than standalone apps.

item.title: GPT-6 Astra Co-Authors Lattice Definition of the Standard Model
item.description:
A physicist used GPT-6 Astra to turn a lattice gauge theory strategy into a full construction, with the model leading the detailed proof of a nonperturbative definition of the Standard Model. The preprint argues for the existence of the simplest unified Yang-Mills theory with gauge fields and fermions via overlap fermions and the continuum limit, marking a substantive role for frontier LLMs in formal theoretical physics.

原文标题：GPT-6 Astra 协助完成标准模型格点定义证明

Why it matters：大模型直接参与理论物理核心证明，是 AI for Science 的标志性案例。

item.title: WisprFlow Debuts In-House Speech Model Canto 1 at 3.4% WER
item.description:
Speech-input startup WisprFlow has hired Ariya Rastrow, a founding Alexa scientist, as chief science officer and shifted from rented speech engines to training its own models. Its first in-house model, Canto 1, was trained on noisy real-world dictation and posted a 3.4% word error rate across roughly 10 hours of real Flow dictations from over 2,300 speakers, beating every competing model Wispr tested while cutting dictations that take over a second to appear by 54%.

原文标题：WisprFlow 自研语音模型 Canto 1 词错率降至 3.4%

Why it matters：语音识别从租用引擎转向自研，并以真实嘈杂场景的低词错率给出可验证结果，是语音交互赛道值得关注的信号。

item.title: Protomaps Makes Self-Hosting Map Tiles Cheap and Easy
item.description:
PMTiles, part of the Protomaps ecosystem, packages an entire map into a single file served via HTTP Range requests, deployable directly to a storage bucket or CDN without running a tile server. It offers developers a low-cost, portable self-hosting alternative to commercial map APIs whose usage-based pricing can spike sharply.

item.title: Eclipse Mosquitto Open Source MQTT Broker Supports MQTT 5.0

item.description:

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 用代码逐笔作画
item.description:
Anthropic 发布语言模型 Claude Fable 5.2，它不直接生成像素图像，而是通过 Python 代码在虚拟画布上逐笔落笔，模拟笔毛纹理与颜料附着等物理特性。演示中它用约 70 万笔完成停车场场景、以 111 组坐标序列画出一只鸟，并在事后覆盖修正偏差。在内部 RoboDojo Sim 基准上得分 64.9%，远超 GPT-6 Astra 的 29.8%，但真实机械臂测试中速度与精细运动控制仍落后。

Why it matters：以代码逐笔作画替代像素生成，并延伸到机械臂控制，是模型能力范式的一次实质性探索。

item.title: AI 生成代码应默认开源的观点论证
item.description:
作者主张所有由 AI 生成的代码都应开源，理由有二：一是模型训练数据大量来自开源代码与 CC 协议内容，闭源化属于“许可洗白”；二是纯 AI 生成物缺乏人类作者，依“猴子自拍案”先例不应享有版权。文章以观点论证为主，未提供新数据或技术方案。

Why it matters：触及 AI 生成物版权与开源许可的核心争议，观点鲜明但属个人论述，适合关注开源合规的读者参考。
